findings.code_snippet:
Return the `.cdp` path and a clickable share URL. If the user asks to open or preview it and browser-control capability is available, navigate that browser to the generated URL and verify that cdp-web loads the graph. Accept the confirmation dialog if cdp-web already has an autosaved patch. If browser control is unavailable, provide the URL without treating that as failure. Do not invoke an OS-level browser merely to satisfy previewing unless the user requested it.

## Output rules

- Preserve editable graph intent; do not replace the patch deliverable with a rendered WAV.
- Give every patch a concise `metadata.name`; add a description when the musical intent is non-obvious.
